source: built from chain 1 JSON-RPC alone: senders and recipients of transfers over 50 ETH in blocks 26300000..26350000 (step 100), kept if they hold over 100 ETH today and their account nonce is above 0 (so their public key is on-chain). Dormancy is proven by an unmoved nonce where the account's last transaction fell inside the sample; other entries carry no dormancy seed and the canary times them from first sighting (accounts with a nonce over 200, contracts and delegated accounts excluded)
